catholic-encyclopedia-1913-anatole-leroy: A 1913 entry on Anatole Leroy-Beaulieu — the French historian of Russia. Georges Goyau praises his Empire of the Tsars. His pages opened the East to France. The Institute crowned his labors. A scholar of empires. His lectures drew the Paris elite.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-baron-de-mont: This 1913 reference piece on Montesquieu — the philosopher of the Spirit of the Laws. Antoine Dégert weighs his famous work. His separation of powers shaped the age. The Church answered his errors. The sage of La Brède. His Persian Letters mocked the Paris salons.
